A '''Shikaaakwan pilot''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Despot Army]] during the [[Despot War]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] pilot was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the last battle of the Despot War when the craft crashed on [[Bogan]]. The pilot's [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]] was still lying near the craft as of [[25,793 BBY]].
